title: Big Thanks: Super Keirin: Dream with Keirin 50 Years
overview:
Big Thanks Super Keirin: Dream with Keirin 50 Years is a keirin bicycle racing simulation made to celebrate fifty years of keirin in Japan. It is a not-for-sale disc produced for the sport's 50th anniversary.

Take your place in the pack on the velodrome, ride the race and push for the finish line to win. Beyond the racing, the disc also offers information about keirin venues around Japan.

- Keirin racing simulation for 1 to 4 players
- Multi Terminal 6 support
- Memory backup support
